name: card
description: Container surface with header, optional divider, body, and footer slots; direct children can participate in grid's four-row alignment mode

changes.note: A media slot and a hover prop. [data-part="media"] is a figure across the top of the card, full bleed, cut to the new --card-media-ratio alias (16 / 9) with its image covering the frame. data-hover names what the card does under the pointer and under focus-within: lift (rises one spacing step), raise (rises and climbs to the new --card-hover-shadow alias, --shadow-lg), tint (the accent along its edge) or zoom (its picture leans in). Nothing changes for markup that carries neither: the resting card reads no new token.

Card visuals now consume the guaranteed elevation ramp: default and outlined use surface-1 with its border, while filled uses surface-2 with its border. Adjacent variants are therefore statically separable in every theme and scheme.

Declared the optional divider slot and the four-direct-row composition used by grid data-align-rows: header, divider, body, footer. The card remains an intrinsic flex column by default; the parent grid owns the subgrid opt-in and its non-subgrid stacking fallback.

media.description: A picture across the top of the card, before the header: a

header.description: Card header area containing title and description

divider.description: Optional separator between the header and body; required as the second direct row when the parent grid opts into four-row card alignment

hover.description: What the card does under the pointer and under focus-within: lift rises one spacing step; raise rises and takes --card-hover-shadow; tint draws the accent along the edge; zoom leans into the media image (needs a media slot). Use on cards that are links or hold one.

templates.html:
{title}

{description}

{body}
{footer}

notes: A card is an intrinsic flex column unless its direct parent grid declares data-align-rows.
The aligned composition fixes exactly four direct rows in this order: header, divider, body, footer. All four must be present on every participating card; content inside a row may differ freely.
